scripts.postinstall: prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=./prisma-central/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=./prisma/branch.schema.prisma
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=./prisma-central/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=./prisma/branch.schema.prisma
scripts.db:push:main: node -e "process.env.CONTROL_DATABASE_URL = process.env.CONTROL_DATABASE_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL || 'postgresql://placeholder:placeholder@localhost:5432/placeholder'; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('npx prisma db push --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.warn('Skipping db:push:main (no live DB connection in build environment)'); }"
scripts.db:push:central: node -e "process.env.CENTRAL_DATABASE_URL = process.env.CENTRAL_DATABASE_URL || process.env.CONTROL_DATABASE_URL || process.env.DATABASE_URL || process.env.POSTGRES_URL || 'postgresql://placeholder:placeholder@localhost:5432/placeholder'; const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { execSync('npx prisma db push --schema=./prisma-central/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) { console.warn('Skipping db:push:central (no live DB connection in build environment)'); }"
